design.source_arm: lib.rs validate(): kind adjustment accepted in the Source arm when the payload is PrimitiveReference{schema_id: hsk.studio.adjustment@1, object_id == own layer id}; output port out, image, one, source (same descriptor as raster).
design.clip_base: Spec reading: STU-RAS-015 defines a clipping mask through 'a base layer's content/alpha'; STU-RAS-007 says an adjustment layer is applied to the layers below '(or clipped to its parent)', i.e. the adjustment layer is the clipped layer; STU-RAS-035 repeats 'clip-to-parent option'. No clause names an adjustment layer as a clip base, so it is refused (matches pigment PlanError::AdjustmentClipBase). The spec is silent rather than prohibiting; Photoshop behaviour UNVERIFIED (Photoshop allows clipping layers to an adjustment layer and limits them to its mask), so this is a Studio rule pending an enrichment or the D5 oracle.
